description: This file provides a generic implementation of background process management infrastructure, including process creation, communication, and lifecycle handling within a larger application, likely related to Git.

classes.name: struct subprocess_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry for a subprocess, including command info and process control data.
classes.notes: Defined as a struct, not as a class with methods.

classes.name: struct child_process
classes.description: Represents a child process for spawning and communication, used internally in subprocess management.

methods.name: int cmd2process_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for subprocess commands used in hashmaps.

methods.name: struct:subprocess_entry * subprocess_find_entry(struct hashmap * hashmap,const char * cmd)
methods.description: Retrieves a subprocess entry from the hashmap by command.

methods.name: int subprocess_read_status(int fd,struct strbuf * status)
methods.description: Reads the status output from a subprocess over a file descriptor.

methods.name: void subprocess_stop(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry)
methods.description: Stops a subprocess, sends termination signals, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: int subprocess_start(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * cmd,subprocess_start_fn startfn)
methods.description: Starts a subprocess, initializes process info, and adds it to the hashmap.

methods.name: void subprocess_exit_handler(struct child_process * process)
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a subprocess exits, including signal handling.

methods.name: int subprocess_handshake(struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)
methods.description: Performs version and capability handshake with a subprocess.

methods.name: int handshake_capabilities(struct child_process * process,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)
int handshake_version(struct child_process * process,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version)
